result.summary: No clearly broken elements beyond the explicitly excluded right-edge carousel clipping and bottom viewport cutoff. The page appears generally intact; only minor contrast/readability concerns are worth noting.

issues.description: Some secondary text such as search placeholder text and gray delivery-time/metadata labels appears relatively low-contrast against white/light backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast for placeholder and metadata text to meet WCAG AA contrast guidelines.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons look slightly crowded around the search/cart area, with a dark horizontal stroke visually connecting or cluttering those icons.
issues.suggestion: Review the tab bar spacing/icon rendering so each navigation item is clearly separated and no unintended line or overlap appears.
